messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: Sev2 — Cache coherence surge + elevated 5xx (INC-32950). Paging oncall. Symptoms: model 5xx spike, prefix/KV cache miss churn. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/cache-coherency (pager attached)

sara: oncall here, acked. jumping in.

mike: tl;dr — around 08:12UTC we saw prefix_cache_miss_rate jump from ~2% to ~38% and model_5xx_rate 6x baseline. Appears correlated with aggressive prefetch + stale KV writes. Affected tenants: tenant-ox (highest), tenant-zen (lower).

jon: metric snippets:
- prefix_cache_miss_rate{env=prod} 0.38 @08:15
- model_5xx_rate{service=inference} 0.06 (was 0.01)
- prefetch_write_errors bumped 4x
Link to dashboards: https://dash/realtime/INC-32950

priya: propose live mitigations (short list):
1) Disable prefetch/prefetcher for impacted tenants (reduces churn).
2) Apply per-tenant rate cap to mitigate fanout (50rps per-tenant initially).
3) Enable KV cache read-bypass (consistency-first) for reads tagged with consistency=true for affected tenants to avoid stale entries.
4) Route new traffic to model-quant-smaller fallback for slower paths.
5) Notify CS and customers with an interim update.

sara: approved. doing 1+2 immediately. mike, can you flip 3? jon work on fallback routing. priya own postmortem.

mike: applying KV bypass for tenant-ox now. command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/tenants/tenant-ox/config"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"kv_cache":{"bypass_reads":true}}'
```
Expect change to take effect within 15s.

sara: disabling prefetch for tenant-ox:```bash
PATCH /v1/tenants/tenant-ox/config
{ "prefetch_enabled": false }
```
applied at 08:23UTC.

ops-pager: applying tenant-level rate limit via traffic policy:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: TenantTrafficPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-ox-cap-50rps
spec:
  tenant: tenant-ox
  rateLimit: 50 # rps
```
kubectl apply -f tenant-ox-cap-50rps.yaml
```
applied at 08:24UTC.

eng-oncall: created a temporary routing rule to route 100% new sessions for tenant-ox to model-quant-smaller-1, rollbackable. policy id: route-32950-fallback.

jon: monitoring: within 3 minutes after mitigations started:
- model_5xx_rate dropped to 0.012 (near baseline)
- prefix_cache_miss_rate down to 5%
- end-to-end p95 latency back within SLO
Initial customer impact: degraded responses for ~12m window, some 5xx for tenant-ox at peak. No data corruption detected so far.

sara: good. cs-bot please send interim update to affected accounts: short note, what we did, expected next update in 2h.

cs-bot: Draft to send to tenant-ox: "We observed elevated errors and latency earlier today; mitigations applied (reduced prefetch, temporary rate limiting, consistency bypass). Service restored to expected levels. Postmortem forthcoming." Approve?

mike: approve. :thumbsup:

priya: setting postmortem owner and timeline: I will own, initial emerald timeline: prelim notes within 24h, full postmortem in 72h. Will record root-cause hypotheses: prefetch concurrency + stale KV write race, rollout of prefetch tuning 2 days ago.

sara: handing monitoring/watch to mike for 2h. I'm on standby. If metrics resurge, escalate paging.

mike: taking 2h watch. I'll keep a short log here. :white_check_mark:

jon: follow-ups for next steps (ticketed):
- pin prefetch change and add canary limit (ENG-32951)
- add KV write-idempotency and stronger write locks (ENG-32952)
- add tenant-level prefetch opt-out flag in UI (ENG-32953)

ops-pager: all mitigations recorded in incident timeline. automated rollback commands prepared.

cs-bot: customer comms sent at 08:40UTC.

mike: monitoring note at 08:50UTC — metrics stable, no new 5xx spikes. I'll escalate if anything changes.

sara: thanks team. oncall handoff performed to mike. leaving this thread open for the watch window.

priya: will run a quick validation in staging for KV bypass path and prepare testcases for the postmortem.

mike: observed small increase in latency for bypassed reads (~20ms) but within tolerable limits.

sara: closing initial mitigation loop. Postmortem owner: priya. Action items assigned.

incident-bot: INC-32950 status updated to "Mitigated - Watch".

mike: :eyes: watching.

sara: :handshake: thanks everyone.
